pattern: も同然だ（もどうぜんだ）
purpose: Treat a situation as effectively equivalent to another.
keywords: No reply is practically a refusal.
Having come this far, it is as good as finished.
At a hundred yen, it is practically free.
restrictions: The situations are practically, rather than literally, identical.
mistake: With nouns such as ただ, spacing does not change the construction.

segments.role: Treat a situation as effectively equivalent to another. N / Vた + も同然だ

examples.translation: No reply is practically a refusal.
